items.title: Gucci Primavera: Visi Baharu Demna Tiba di Bangkok
items.summary: Malay-language regional fashion title covers Gucci's Primavera collection event held at ICONSIAM Bangkok, framing it as Demna's fresh creative vision arriving in Southeast Asia. Article could not be fully fetched (403 blocked) but headline and search-index date confirm coverage of the Sept 4 Bangkok activation.

items.title: ICONSIAM posts looks from Gucci Primavera launch with TeeTeePor
items.summary: ICONSIAM's official X account posted looks worn by Thai celebrity duo TeeTee and Por at the Gucci Primavera collection launch at The Pinnacle, ICONSIAM (Sept 4 event), using hashtag #GucciPrimaveraxTeeTeePor. Promotional/activation content amplified by mall-venue account.

items.title: Fan account announces TeeTee and Por attendance at Gucci Primavera event
items.summary: Thai entertainment fan account DomundiTV posted event details ahead of TeeTee (Wanpichit) and Por (Suppakarn) attending Gucci's Primavera event at ICONSIAM on Sept 4, 2026, generating pre-event buzz among Thai fandom communities.

items.title: Fan thread compiling Gucci Primavera x TeeTeePor media coverage
items.summary: A Thai fan account compiled media coverage of the TeeTeePor duo's appearance at Gucci's Primavera event and called on followers to like/repost/comment to boost the pair's visibility with press. Reflects organic fandom-driven amplification of the brand activation, distinct from Gucci's own marketing feed.

items.title: "Gucci reputation really had fallen jialat" — Singapore forum thread
items.summary: Singaporean community forum thread with overwhelmingly negative sentiment toward Gucci: heavy discounting ("up to 50% off") is described as eroding exclusivity, one poster predicts the brand becomes "luxury trash tier," widespread counterfeit nylon goods are said to undermine authenticity, and users recommend Hermes/Goyard/LV as superior alternatives. Directly responsive to the critical-angle search requirement; captures grassroots SEA consumer sentiment on brand devaluation. Older than the ideal freshness window but retained as one of the few genuine critical community threads surfaced.

items.title: Hanoi police seize fake Louis Vuitton and Gucci bags
items.summary: Vietnamese national outlet reports Hanoi police confiscated counterfeit Gucci handbags, wallets, clutches and belts (priced VND 2-10 million) from an operation that had distributed 129 fake luxury items since early 2026, netting an estimated VND 714 million (~$27,000) in illicit revenue. Signals ongoing counterfeit-market drag on Gucci's brand integrity in Vietnam; part of a recurring SEA counterfeit-enforcement pattern.

items.title: Gulf Kanawut's brand collaborations in 2026: Gucci, Onitsuka Tiger, Sulwhasoo and more
items.summary: Tatler Asia profiles Thai actor Gulf Kanawut, Gucci's first Thai male brand ambassador since March 2024, continuing under Demna's new creative direction. Notes his minimalist styling at the February 2026 Milan show became one of the most widely shared moments of the event, underscoring Thai celebrity amplification of Gucci's global campaigns. Retained for regional-ambassador context despite being outside the ideal freshness window.
